There was a Protestant man and a Catholic man discussing recent policies for women's rights in the library recently. The Protestant man had a pretty positive reaction, since he strongly believes men and women are equal, but the Catholic man strongly disagreed, stating plainly that women are below men and the rules of society should reflect that. Who respects women?
A. The Protestant man
B. The Catholic man
C. Not enough info
